practice_areas: Federal Tort Claims Act Sexual Abuse
firm_data.firm_description: Marsh Law Firm is a legal services company that focuses on representing survivors of sexual abuse and discrimination, advocating for their clients both in and out of the courtroom to secure justice and hold perpetrators and institutions accountable.
notable_facts: Recognized worldwide as a premier law firm representing victims of lapsed claims for childhood sexual abuse.

Instrumental in passing major laws on behalf of victims and survivors of childhood sexual abuse including the federal Amy Vicky and Andy Act, the Protecting Young Victims from Sexual Abuse and Safe Sport Authorization Act, the States and Victims to Fight Online Sex Trafficking Act (FOSTA), Masha’s Law, and New York’s Child Victim’s Act.
Created the Children’s Justice Fund to serve victims of child trafficking, child sex abuse, online child sexual exploitation, and child pornography.
